title: Precor Console Stays Blank
shortDescription: Display does not light up after step-on or key insertion.
fullDescription: Precor self-powered ellipticals (EFX) generate display power from pedaling. A blank console can mean low strides, aged battery (where present), or harness fault.

fixSteps.title: Replace 4xAA battery
fixSteps.instruction: Open console rear; replace AA cells in self-powered models.

fixSteps.title: Check harness
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat the upright cable plug at the lower frame.

whenToCallPro: If new batteries and harness reseat don't help.

faq.a: Most consumer EFX yes; commercial 800-line uses AC.

title: Precor Treadmill Speed Surges or Drops
fullDescription: Erratic speed on Precor treadmills is usually caused by a worn drive belt, dirty motor commutator, or speed sensor noise.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drive belt
fixSteps.instruction: Open hood; check drive belt for cracks/glaze.

whenToCallPro: If brushes/sensor measurements out of spec.

title: Precor Elliptical Clicking from Pedal Arm
fullDescription: Click is typically a loose pedal arm bolt, dry bearing, or worn ramp roller. Tighten arm hardware and lubricate bearings per service manual.

fixSteps.title: Tighten hardware
fixSteps.instruction: Torque pedal arm bolts to spec.

fixSteps.title: Lubricate bearings
fixSteps.instruction: Apply white lithium grease to pivots.

title: Precor EFX Crossramp Will Not Adjust
shortDescription: Ramp angle does not change with button press.
fullDescription: Precor's CrossRamp uses a screw-drive motor with a position pot. A jammed screw or failed pot blocks adjustment.

fixSteps.title: Calibration
fixSteps.instruction: Run ramp self-cal in tech mode.

faq.a: Service manual specifies key combo per model.

title: Precor Bike Stops Counting Pedal Strokes
shortDescription: RPM and watts read 0 even while pedaling.
fullDescription: RPM sensor on the flywheel has lost signal. Reseating the sensor and aligning gap restores reading. On commercial bikes, sensor magnet on flywheel can also fall off.

fixSteps.title: Reseat sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Open shroud; reseat sensor at MCB and flywheel side.

whenToCallPro: If sensor is bad after testing.

faq.a: Use medium-strength threadlocker per service manual.

title: Precor Treadmill Belt Stalls When Stepping On
shortDescription: Belt stops or hesitates with body weight.
fullDescription: Stalling under load points to friction (lube needed) or weak motor brushes. Always lubricate before assuming hardware fault.
whenToCallPro: If lube doesn't fix and amp test confirms motor weakness.

title: Precor LED Display Has Dead Segments
shortDescription: Some characters missing on numeric display.
fullDescription: Aged LED segments on Precor P30/P10 displays fade with use. Console replacement is the standard fix.
whenToCallPro: Always for console swap unless experienced.

title: Precor P82 Touchscreen Frozen
fullDescription: Power cycle resets the embedded Android. If repeated, console firmware reflash is required.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Trip the unit's switch for 60 sec.

faq.a: Use damp cloth; no harsh cleaners.

title: Precor Preva Network Offline
shortDescription: Console cannot reach Preva cloud for content.
fullDescription: Preva entertainment console requires internet via Wi-Fi or wired Ethernet. Captive-portal Wi-Fi or DNS issues commonly block sign-in.

fixSteps.title: Use enterprise Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Avoid captive portals; use WPA2 PSK.

title: Precor Treadmill Emergency Cord Lockout
fullDescription: Pulled cord opens the safety circuit. Reset by reseating the magnetic clip; check microswitch if it still won't start.
